feed.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?

entry.title: RFC: Two years of BIP Editing, time for some new faces?
entry.summary:
Daniela has demonstrated consistent and sustained activity as a reviewer, as shown in 30, 60, and 90-day snapshots of her contributions. This ongoing engagement highlights her potential as an up-and-coming reviewer within the repository. In comparison, Edil’s technical reviews have been substantial over a longer period, yet his participation has been less regular in recent times.
The author reflects on their own recent involvement, noting minimal activity due to dedicating most efforts elsewhere, such as at [roasbeef's GitHub](https://github.com/roasbeef). Given this shift in focus, the decision has been made to step down from the current reviewer role at the end of the year. Daniela is recommended as a suitable candidate to assume this position, given her consistent record and evident commitment to the project.
